lines.en: label iosummer2bathgen:
scene iosummer2bathgen
I head to the bathhouse to spend some time with Io and, instead, get coerced into taking off all of my clothes.
lines.zh: 我去澡堂想陪 Io 待一会儿，结果反倒被哄着把衣服全脱了。

lines.en: The first part of my mission is still completed, however, as Io (With all of her clothes unfortunately still on) sits behind me the way she’s done before and kills the silence with the sound of her voice.
lines.zh: 不过我这次任务的前半段还是完成了——Io（不幸的是她还穿着整身衣服）像从前那样坐在我身后，用自己的声音填满了沉默。

lines.en: She tells me more about the bathhouse and how she’s thankful that her aunt allows her to live here so long as she helps out from time to time.
lines.zh: 她又给我讲了许多澡堂的事，说她很感激姑姑允许她住在这里，只要她时不时帮忙打点就行。

lines.en: The thing is “from time to time” seems more like “all the time” as I have never once met Io’s aunt while Io always happens to be here.
lines.zh: 问题是「时不时」听起来更像「一直」——因为我一次都没见过 Io 的姑姑，而 Io 却总在这儿。

lines.en: I guess that she’s never had much reason to leave until recently, though.
lines.zh: 不过我想，直到最近之前她都没什么理由离开这里。

lines.en: And given that both Uta and I are the only people she willingly associates with, somewhere like this actually seems pretty good for her.
lines.zh: 考虑到 Uta 和我是她唯一愿意主动交往的人，这种地方对她来说其实挺不错的。

lines.en: It’s quiet, but not too quiet. And sure, there are plenty of girls who come and go, but all of them are off in a private room while Io is free to...
lines.zh: 这里安静，但又不至于太安静。当然，来来去去的女孩子不少，可她们都待在包间里，而 Io 却可以自由地……

lines.en: Well, creepily sit behind her naked, adult male teacher and talk to him about the history of the bathhouse.
lines.zh: 呃，就这么阴森森地坐在她那位裸体的成年男教师身后，跟他聊澡堂的历史。

lines.en: scene black
Wanting the conversation to move in a more interesting direction, I begin dropping scattered innuendos about how Io should join me in the water.
lines.zh: 我想把话题引向更有意思的方向，便开始东一句西一句地暗示 Io 也该下水来陪我。

lines.en: They either go unnoticed or ignored, though...as she deflects every single one of them with the thick side of another bathhouse fact, leaving me alone and bored in the water until I have no choice but to get out.
lines.zh: 可这些暗示不是没被听懂，就是被无视了……她用另一条厚厚的澡堂冷知识把每一个都挡了回去，把我一个人无聊地丢在水里，直到我别无选择只能起身。

lines.en: Without looking at me, Io gets up as well to find me a towel and tosses it my way before retreating back to the lobby.
lines.zh: Io 看也不看我，也站起身给我找了条毛巾扔过来，然后退回前台去了。

lines.en: I get dressed, feeling unfulfilled and mildly confused, before exiting the changing room and finding her back in her usual spot behind the counter.
lines.zh: 我穿上衣服，心里空落落的又有点莫名其妙；走出更衣室，发现她已经回到柜台后那个老位置上了。

lines.en: She tries to strike up another conversation, but when I notice the time on the clock behind her, I realize exactly how long I must have spent in the bath and have to cut her off.
lines.zh: 她想再挑起话头，可我瞥见她身后钟上的时间，才意识到自己究竟在浴池里泡了多久，只好打断她。

lines.en: She’s noticeably upset, but seems to understand as I turn my back to her and leave the bathhouse.
lines.zh: 她明显有些失落，但我背过身走出澡堂时，她似乎也理解了。

lines.en: But at least I’m leaving knowing much more about it.
lines.zh: 但至少我走的时候，对这里了解得多了不少。

{i}Io’s affection has increased to [io_love]!{/i}
